name: Ferienwohnung Schnalzger
beschreibung:
Situated on the high plateau of Bad Haering, Ferienwohnung Schnalzger provides comfortable lodgings with bright rooms and a balcony overlooking the Inn Valley.

The health centre with sulphur springs and scenic trails are right nearby.
kurzbeschreibung: Ferienwohnung Schnalzger in Bad Haering offers sunny holiday living in Tyrol's renowned spa village.
